newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian farm ministry targets 1997 output - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russian farm ministry targets 1997 output - agency.

text.p: Russia's Agriculture Ministry has targeted net grain production at 70 million tonnes in the 1997 calendar year, compared with a net harvest of 69.3 million tonnes in 1996, according to Interfax news agency.

Russia's 1997 sugar beet production is targeted at 22 million tonnes, above the 16.1 million tonnes produced in 1996, and oilseed output would rise to a net 4.3 million tonnes from a net 2.8 million last year, it said on Monday.
The agency, quoting material prepared for the ministry by a group of experts, also said that beef and poultry production was targeted at 8.5 million tonnes, compared to 8.6 million in 1996.
Russia's 1996 net grain harvest was the second poor return in a row following 1995 output of 63.4 million tonnes, and was one of the worse results in three decades.
